articles.title: Bitcoin ETF Gold Rush Turns Into An Epic Bust
articles.mainIdea: Bitcoin ETF Gold Rush Turns Into An Epic Bust
articles.summary: Investor's Business Daily: Bitcoin ETF Gold Rush Turns Into An Epic Bust. The bitcoin ETF gold rush is turning into an epic bust. And it's getting uglier by the day. Shares of the 10 largest bitcoin ETFs, including iShares Bitcoin Trust, Fidelity Wise Origin Bitcoin and Grayscale Bitcoin Trust, are down an average of 49% from their highest levels in 52 weeks, says an Investor's Business Daily analysis of data from S&P Global Market Intelligence and MarketSurge. Related tickers mentioned: BTC-USD, FBTC, GBTC, IBIT, SPY, ^GSPC.
